integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof by an exact resolvent derivative factorization; exact symbolic and independent rational finite checks; no empirical or numerical enumeration substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Weak excitation; symmetric two-state Markov frequency fluctuations; leading-order frequency-integrated intensity. Rates approach zero only as one-sided limits; no assertion for strong drive, asymmetry, or arbitrary frequency-resolved spectra. Earlier two-state lineshape formulas imply the underlying response, and priority of explicit global phase classification is not independently established.
title: A complete switching-rate phase diagram and invariant-flux point for telegraph-noisy resonance fluorescence
